_comment: SYNTHETIC charts only (CLAUDE.md rule: never real birth data, names, or coordinates).
Engineering scaffolds this worksheet; the chief Thirukanitham specialist annotates the
TODO rows (input placements + expected band/reading per life area). Once a row's status
flips to DONE, wire it into a parametrized pytest case mirroring
tests/golden/reasoning/marriage_promise_gate.json, which remains the source of truth for
those three -- they are reproduced here only so this file is a complete 20-row picture).
Coverage target: every Reading value (PROMISED_AND_TIMED, PROMISED_NOT_NOW,
ACTIVE_BUT_UNPROMISED, NOT_PROMISED, MIXED, SILENT) appears at least twice, and every
life area in app/services/life_areas_service.py::_AREA_ROUTING appears at least once.
'varga' below names the area's varga per _AREA_ROUTING (e.g. RELATIONSHIPS -> D9,
CAREER -> D10) -- the input's d_varga_rasi_by_planet map should place that area's karaka
in that varga, per the Phase 1 promise-gate spec (plan §Phase 1).

schema.name: short_snake_case_id
schema.target_area: one of _AREA_ROUTING's keys -- the life area this chart is annotated for
schema.target_reading: the Reading value this chart is meant to exercise (coverage bookkeeping)
schema.annotation: specialist's prose: which lord/karaka placements drive the gate grade, and why (blank until filled)

input.planets_rasi: dict PLANET -> rasi 1-12, all nine grahas placed in D1
input.varga: the varga code this row exercises, e.g. 'D9', 'D10'
input.varga_rasi_by_planet: dict PLANET -> rasi 1-12 in that varga, at least for the area's karaka(s)
input.active_dasha_lords: list of maha/antar lords currently running
input.transits: dict PLANET -> rasi 1-12 (transit positions as of as_of_date)
input.as_of_date: YYYY-MM-DD anchor date for the transits/dasha above
input.age: int, synthetic native's age as of as_of_date
input.afflictions: dict of area-relevant affliction flags, e.g. {"karaka_combust": false, "dosham_cancelled": true}

expected.band: STRONG | LIKELY | MIXED | WEAK | BLOCKED | SILENT
expected.reading: PROMISED_AND_TIMED | PROMISED_NOT_NOW | ACTIVE_BUT_UNPROMISED | NOT_PROMISED | MIXED | SILENT
expected.window_note: free text, e.g. 'opens ~2029 when Venus dasha begins' (optional)

coverage_table.note: maraka_risk=True area -- extra care that BLOCKED reads as redirect, not doom (D6)
